actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Google Cloud Storage (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Google Workspace action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Google Workspace connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_bucket
actions.title: Create bucket
actions.description: Create bucket in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Creates a new bucket in the Google Cloud Storage system. Bucket name must be unique in the system.

input.name: name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket to be created. Bucket name must be unique. For more information, see the bucket naming guidelines .

actions.name: delete_bucket
actions.title: Delete bucket
actions.description: Delete bucket in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Deletes a bucket in the Google Cloud Storage system. Ensure that the bucket does not contain any objects before deleting it.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket which is to be deleted.

actions.name: delete_object
actions.title: Delete Object
actions.description: Delete Object in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Deletes an object and its metadata in the Google Cloud Storage system. Deletions are permanent if versioning is not enabled for the bucket.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket the object is to be deleted from.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object name
input.hint: The name of the object which is to be deleted.

input.name: generation
input.label: Generation
input.hint: If present, permanently deletes a specific revision of this object (as opposed to the latest version, the default).

input.name: ifGenerationMatch
input.label: If generation matches
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current generation matches the given value. Setting to 0 makes the operation succeed only if there are no live versions of the object.

input.name: ifGenerationNotMatch
input.label: If generation does not match
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current generation does not match the given value. If no live object exists, the precondition fails. Setting to 0 makes the operation succeed on…

input.name: ifMetagenerationMatch
input.label: If Meta generation matches
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration matches the given value.

input.name: ifMetagenerationNotMatch
input.label: If Meta generation does not match
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration does not match the given value.

actions.name: download_object
actions.title: Download object
actions.description: Download Object from Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Downloads an object and its metadata in the Google Cloud Storage system.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: Enter the name of the bucket from which to download. The remaining part of the path should be specified in Object name .

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object name
input.hint: Enter the name of the object to be downloaded. The name should include the full path relative to the bucket, including any folders and subfolders from which the object will be downloaded. For example,…

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.

actions.name: get_bucket
actions.title: Get bucket
actions.description: Get details of a bucket in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Get details of a bucket in the Google Cloud Storage system.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket which is to be retrieved.

actions.name: get_object_metadata
actions.title: Get object metadata
actions.description: Get metadata of an Object Object from Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Get an object’s metadata without downloading the object contents in the Google Cloud Storage system.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket to retrieve object metadata from.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object name
input.hint: The name of the object to be retrieve object metadata from.

actions.name: list_buckets
actions.title: List buckets
actions.description: List buckets within a project in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: List the details of all buckets within a project in the Google Cloud Storage system.

input.name: prefix
input.label: Prefix
input.hint: Filter results to buckets whose names begin with this prefix.

input.name: pageToken
input.label: Page token
input.hint: A previously-returned page token representing part of the larger set of results to view.

input.name: maxResults
input.label: Max results
input.hint: Maximum number of buckets to return in a single response. The service will use the smaller of this parameter or: 200 items if projection=full OR 1,000 items if projection=noAcl.

actions.name: list_objects
actions.title: List Objects
actions.description: List objects within a bucket in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: List the details of all objects within a bucket in the Google Cloud Storage system.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket.

input.name: prefix
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: List files and folders in a particular folder. If blank, it will list all objects in the selected bucket. Define the full path, e.g. folder 1/subfolder 1. If your delimiter is not “/” please define th…

input.name: delimiter
input.label: Delimiter
input.hint: Default Delimiter is set to “/”. If you have a customized delimiter, please add it here.

input.name: startOffset
input.label: Start offset
input.hint: Filter results to objects whose names are lexicographically equal to or after startOffset. If endOffset is also set, the objects listed have names between startOffset (inclusive) and endOffset (exclus…

input.name: endOffset
input.label: End offset
input.hint: Filter results to objects whose names are lexicographically before endOffset. If startOffset is also set, the objects listed have names between startOffset (inclusive) and endOffset (exclusive).

input.name: projection
input.label: Projection
input.hint: Set of properties to return. Defaults to No ACL.

input.name: maxResults
input.label: Max results
input.hint: Maximum results to be returned from API. Default value and maximum allowed value is 200

input.name: pageToken
input.label: Page token
input.hint: Token to specify the next page in a query. This can be found from the output of an earlier List buckets action. If the page token is null, there are no more pages.

input.name: versions
input.label: Versions
input.hint: If ‘Yes’, lists all versions of an object as distinct results in order of increasing generation number. Set as ‘No’ by default.

actions.name: update_bucket
actions.title: Update bucket
actions.description: Update bucket in Google Cloud Storage
actions.help: Updates an existing bucket in the Google Cloud Storage system. Make sure the bucket already exists within the project.

input.name: bucket_name
input.label: Bucket name
input.hint: The name of the bucket which is to be updated.

input.name: ifGenerationNotMatch
input.label: If generation does not match
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current generation does not match the given value. If no live object exists, the precondition fails. Setting to 0 makes the operation succeed on…

input.name: ifMetagenerationMatch
input.label: If Meta generation matches
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration matches the given value.

input.name: ifMetagenerationNotMatch
input.label: If Meta generation does not match
input.hint: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration does not match the given value.

input.name: metadata
input.label: Metadata
input.hint: User-provided metadata, in key/value pairs.
